info.title: ICT Management Toolkit API
info.description: REST API of the ICT Management Toolkit. Authenticate with a personal access token (`php artisan core:api-token`) sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Token abilities narrow what a token may do; the user's own permissions apply to every request. Responses are scoped to the user's current organization.

or deputy), `filter[department_id]`, `filter[documented]` (true/false), `filter[search]` (code or name).
Sorts: `code`, `name`, `next_review_on`, `updated_at`; by code by default.

status.description: Keys of the editable lists (Administration → Application portfolio).

documentation_version.description: The version in force of the documentation sheet, e.g. "2.1"; null until one is approved.

likelihood.description: 1–5 on the organization's scale, with impact; both null clears the assessment.

catalog_entry_ids.description: Threats and vulnerabilities from the catalog.

AssetType.description: What a risk can concern. Mirrored by risk_risk_assets_type_check.
AssetType.title: AssetType

notify.description: E-mail the person a handover receipt to acknowledge (default true).

status.description: Back in stock, in or out of repair, retired or lost. Handing out: the assign endpoint; disposal: on screen.

attributes.description: Key, label, type, required, help and options of each attribute.

outgoing.description: Relationships where this item is the source: "this <type> target".

incoming.description: Relationships where this item is the target: "source <type> this".

type.description: A record of the toolkit, e.g. "risk.risk", "bcm.plan", "ticketing.ticket", "documentation.page".

evidence.description: Links to records of the toolkit, and uploaded files (listed, downloaded on screen).

ControlStatus.description: How far a control is implemented. Mirrored by audit_controls_status_check.
ControlStatus.title: ControlStatus

FindingActionRequest.description: Adding a corrective action (POST) or moving it on (PATCH: status only).
FindingActionRequest.title: FindingActionRequest

FindingSeverity.description: ISO/IEC 27001 practice (clause 10.2): nonconformities need a root cause and corrective action; observations and opportunities for improvement do not. Mirrored by audit_findings_severity_check.
FindingSeverity.title: FindingSeverity

Impact.description: How much of the business is affected. Mirrored by a CHECK constraint.
Impact.title: Impact

LicenseModel.description: How a licence is counted: seats for people, seats for devices, or a site licence without a count (who uses it can still be recorded).
LicenseModel.title: LicenseModel

user_id.description: A person, for licences counted per user.

asset_id.description: A device, for licences counted per device.

Modules.Audit.Domain.Enums.ActionStatus.description: Status of a corrective action. Mirrored by audit_finding_actions_status_check.
Modules.Audit.Domain.Enums.ActionStatus.title: Modules.Audit.Domain.Enums.ActionStatus

in_force.description: The approved version: what to do when the plan is activated.

PlanType.description:
| | |---| | `bcp`
How the business keeps working: people, places, manual workarounds. | | `drp`
How IT brings systems back. |
PlanType.title: PlanType

tier.description: From the approved impact analysis; null until one is approved.

RelationshipType.description: How items relate. Read as "source <type> target": an application *runs on* a server, a service *depends on* a database, a node *is part of* a cluster.
RelationshipType.title: RelationshipType

state.description: undecided, not_applicable, not_covered, planned, partial or implemented.

RiskActionRequest.description: Adding a treatment action (POST) or moving it on (PATCH: status only).
RiskActionRequest.title: RiskActionRequest

RiskStatus.description: Mirrored by risk_risks_status_check. Treatment states come with treatment plans.
RiskStatus.title: RiskStatus

SaveApplicationRequest.description:
Registering (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) an application.
Its documentation sheet is written, submitted and approved on screen.

department_id.description: Scoped: departments of other organizations are not found.

SaveApplicationRequest.title: SaveApplicationRequest

SaveAssetRequest.description:
Creating (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) an asset. The
status is chosen at creation only (ordered or in stock); afterwards it
changes through the assign and status endpoints, as on screen.
SaveAssetRequest.title: SaveAssetRequest

SaveConfigurationItemRequest.description:
Creating (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) a configuration
item. Authorization is the controller's, through the policy.

properties.description: Attribute values of the type, keyed by attribute key; checked against the type's schema.

SaveConfigurationItemRequest.title: SaveConfigurationItemRequest

SaveControlRequest.description: Creating (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) a control.
SaveControlRequest.title: SaveControlRequest

SaveFindingRequest.description:
Raising (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) a finding. Submitting
it for verification and verifying it stay on screen.

audit_id.description: The audit it was found in; set at creation only.

SaveFindingRequest.title: SaveFindingRequest

SaveLicenseRequest.description:
Creating (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) a licence. The key
can be set or removed, never read.

product_name.description: A new product of this name, when no product_id is given.

SaveLicenseRequest.title: SaveLicenseRequest

SavePlanRequest.description:
Creating (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) a plan. Its content
is written in versions, submitted and approved on screen.
SavePlanRequest.title: SavePlanRequest

SaveProcessRequest.description:
Creating (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) a business process.
Its impact analysis is filled in, submitted and approved on screen.

department_id.description: Scoped: departments of other organizations are not found.

SaveProcessRequest.title: SaveProcessRequest

SaveRiskRequest.description:
Registering (POST) or changing (PATCH: only the fields sent) a risk. Its
assessment and treatment have their own endpoints, open to the risk's owner.
SaveRiskRequest.title: SaveRiskRequest

StoreAlertmanagerAlertsRequest.description:
Prometheus Alertmanager's webhook payload, as it sends it (ADR 0067). The
item comes from the `ci` label, else `instance` (without its port), else
`host`; the severity from the `severity` label.
StoreAlertmanagerAlertsRequest.title: StoreAlertmanagerAlertsRequest

StoreMonitoringAlertRequest.description:
An alert in the toolkit's own format, which most monitoring tools can send
through their webhook templates (ADR 0067).

key.description: Stable for one problem, e.g. "<host>:<check>": repeats find the open incident by it.

StoreMonitoringAlertRequest.title: StoreMonitoringAlertRequest

TestResult.description: What a control test found. Mirrored by audit_control_tests_result_check.
TestResult.title: TestResult

Treatment.description: ISO/IEC 27005 risk treatment options. Mirrored by risk_risks_treatment_check.
Treatment.title: Treatment

Urgency.description: How quickly the business needs it. Mirrored by a CHECK constraint.
Urgency.title: Urgency

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
